title: Pathing Plus
description:
Pathing Plus is designed to help you draw better paths (and hopefully make
better pathing decisions as a result).

Features include:

- Use the draw and eraser tools to map out your path - straight lines snap to the path you draw.
- Alternate map views - fit the entire map on screen vertically or horizontally.
- Automatic route analysis: how many elites / fires / events are there on each path?
- Improved gamepad support for the map features (left analog button to switch between draw and eraser tools, right trigger to switch between map views, scroll the map with the right analog stick (only if Steam Input is disabled))

Feedback and feature requests always welcome!

Source code and issue tracker:
https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-pathing-plus
changeNote:
- Path drawing is now its own tool, a fourth icon in the map's drawing toolbar beside the quill, the eraser and Clear. Select it and strokes plan a route; it lights up the way the other tools do.
- The quill goes back to being the game's quill. It draws ink again, because planning no longer has to borrow it.
- The eraser rubs out both: the game's ink and the mod's plan, whichever the cursor passes over.
- Override Drawing Controls is now Right-Drag Draws Paths, and covers exactly that: with it on, right-dragging the map picks up the path tool instead of the quill. Middle-drag is still the eraser.
- Clicking the left stick reaches for the path tool, and again for the eraser.
- The path tool has a keyboard shortcut, Q by default. It sits in Settings > Input with the game's own bindings and can be rebound there.
- The new button has a hover tip, like the rest of the tray, naming the key it is bound to.
- Experimental: the path tool now leaves ink under the pen, fading over a second and drifting onto the nearest map line as it goes. Turn it off with Drawing Trail in the settings.
